content:
sam: Quick thread to finalize the private-deploy networking fallback policy we ship with the next release. Focus: SLA-configurable behavior, telemetry, and customer consent model.

neha: TL;DR: fallback options: secondary-peering, quarantine-mode(503), hosted-proxy(opt-in). Need clear per-tenant policy + Console UX.

dmitri: Engineering constraints: hosted-proxy requires envelope encryption and audit trail. Secondary peering switch can be brittle for on-prem (BGP), so make timing a soft target and configurable.

olivia: From support: customers want deterministic visible states and webhook alerts. They also want a simple toggle for "require manual ops approval" before any hosted fallback.

frank: Legal check (legal-bot): hosted fallback = outbound egress; must surface to contract and obtain signed acceptance. Add compliance flag per-tenant.

sam: Proposed contract/API fields: `networking.state` = healthy|degraded|quarantined, `fallback.mode`=none|secondary|hosted|manual-approval, `fallback.reason` string code, `fallback.started_at` timestamp. Console shows live value + history.

neha: Proposed SLA knobs per tenant: `secondary_switch_target_seconds` (default 60), `quarantine_retry_window_secs` (default 30), `hosted_fallback_enabled` boolean, `hosted_fallback_consent_doc_signed` boolean.

dmitri: Implementation sketch: small controller (FallbackManager) that: reads tenant policy on request, evaluates network probes, emits decision. Pseudocode: ```
decision = fallbackManager.evaluate(tenant, request)
switch(decision.mode) {
 case 'secondary': routeToSecondary(); break;
 case 'hosted': if (tenant.hosted_consent) proxyToHosted(); else enterQuarantine(); break;
 case 'manual-approval': notifyOpsAndQuarantine(); break;
 default: quarantineRespond503();
}
```

olivia: Observability: expose metrics per-tenant: fallback_events_total, fallback_duration_seconds_bucket, fallback_drop_count, fallback_consent_status. Dashboards + CSV export.

frank: Retention: default audit retention 90d; enterprise customers can opt to 1y. Must include trace id and request hashes (no plain hostnames).

sam: UX notes: Console opt-in flow should include a modal with consequences, legal checkbox, and an exportable consent PDF. Manual-approval flow should let customers list ops emails and set an approval TTL.

neha: Testing: QA to run blackout scenario: loss of primary peering, flaky BGP converge, and hosted-proxy path. Validate: 1) no internal host headers leak, 2) session affinity preserved when possible, 3) overall latency percentile stays within target for read-only paths.

dmitri: Edge-case: if secondary peering becomes partially available (packet loss), we should prefer quarantine-mode with exponential backoff rather than immediate switch to hosted. Add a health-score threshold.

olivia: Field readiness deliverables: 1) runbook with decision matrix, 2) customer checklist for opt-in, 3) support playbook for manual failover.

deploy-bot: deploy status: feature/priv-fallback-sla rolled to staging 2026-03-21T14:02Z - smoke 3/3, metrics collector enabled.

sam: Action items:
- neha: write Console opt-in UI copy + consent PDF flow (due Tue)
- dmitri: implement FallbackManager, health-score, and per-tenant knobs (sprint+1)
- olivia: create dashboards + webhook templates (due EOW)
- frank/legal-bot: draft contract addendum + retention options (due Wed)
- qa: blackout test harness + header-leak assertions (waiting on neha's test plan)

neha: One unresolved question: default behavior for legacy tenants that haven't set policy? Suggest default to 'quarantine' (503) and surface a banner prompting opt-in for hosted fallback.

dmitri: Agree. Safer default.

sam: OK. I'll publish a minimal acceptance checklist from this thread and attach to the release notes. If no major objections, mark canonical and move to the private-deploy runbook. :white_check_mark:
